evals.prompt: Create a k6 load test script for our Koa backend that tests concurrent traffic ramps from 5 up to 50 users and asserts p95 latency stays below 500ms.

assertions.description: Asserts k6 script ramps to 50 concurrent virtual users
Asserts p95 threshold is enforced below 500ms
Asserts error rate threshold stays below 1%

evals.prompt: Write a Koa middleware that records route execution duration in milliseconds, assigns a correlation x-request-id, and emits structured JSON logs.

assertions.description: Verifies high-resolution timer is used for latency calculation
Verifies correlation ID is set on response header
Verifies duration in milliseconds is recorded in log payload

evals.prompt: Configure Sequelize to log queries that take longer than 200ms with their execution duration.

assertions.description: Verifies Sequelize benchmark flag is enabled
Verifies timing parameter is captured and filtered against 200ms threshold
